fits.reasoning: Private-markets valuation is relevant, but the work is weighted toward monitoring, valuation control and reporting, with a material real-estate focus rather than transaction modelling.
This is hands-on corporate treasury across liquidity, cash and financial-risk management; the fixed-term context does not change the strong role-content fit.

The role directly supports energy-trading risk with trading desks and owns market-risk models; although quantitative, modelling is applied to real trading-risk decisions rather than being pure software development.
The role offers analytical FP&A, business cases and performance improvement, but remains manufacturing business partnering rather than treasury, transactions or investment work.
The work is solid FP&A and performance analysis with budgeting and forecasting, but much of the remit is recurring close, reporting and operational manufacturing control.
The analytical risk-policy ownership is substantive, but it is consumer-credit underwriting and SQL-heavy decisioning rather than markets, liquidity or treasury risk.
The role centres on investment models, independent valuation and M&A work; its graduate academy framing is a seniority issue outside C and does not weaken the intrinsic content fit.
The securities context and risk reporting are relevant, but the day-to-day mix is dominated by controlling, KPI reporting and fee-control processes rather than market-risk analysis.
Company valuation, financial modelling, due diligence and transaction execution are directly on-target; restructuring work broadens rather than displaces the deal-finance core.
The role provides direct M&A execution, valuation and merger modelling and transaction materials, making it a clear corporate-finance target role.
Portfolio risk, stress testing, derivatives, limit steering and performance attribution constitute practical investment-risk work rather than generic compliance reporting.
Despite the controller title, the role is supply-chain demand and inventory planning rather than finance, treasury, investment or financial-risk work.
The role combines FP&A with credit-portfolio and opportunity modelling, but its core remains broad business controlling rather than investment or transaction execution.
Strategic finance for renewables and storage is attractive, but the remit is primarily business partnering and finance transformation rather than transaction or investment execution.
